cards.claim: Progressive image size increase during training accelerates training but reduces accuracy
cards.conditions: Image classification (ImageNet, CIFAR, Cars, Flowers datasets); supervised training with convolutional networks
cards.effect: Training speed improvement; accuracy drop occurs
cards.evidence: Empirical results from EfficientNetV2 training experiments on multiple datasets
cards.quote: Our training can be further sped up by progressively increasing the image size during training, but it often causes a drop in accuracy.

cards.claim: Adaptive regularization adjustment (dropout, data augmentation) recovers accuracy lost from progressive image size scheduling
cards.conditions: Progressive image size training schedule on ImageNet/CIFAR/Cars/Flowers; supervised training with convolutional networks
cards.effect: Eliminates accuracy drop from progressive learning while retaining training speed gains; achieves both fast training and high accuracy
cards.evidence: Empirical validation on multiple datasets showing EfficientNetV2 outperforms prior models under progressive learning strategy
cards.quote: To compensate for this accuracy drop, we propose to adaptively adjust regularization (e.g., dropout and data augmentation) as well, such that we can achieve both fast training and good accuracy.
